The '''MX-05 Constructor Droid''' was a model of four-legged [[Construction droid/Legends|construction droid]] used by [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]], a freelance [[Spy/Legends|spy]] active during the [[Galactic War]]. An MX-05 Constructor Droid repurposed as a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] was among the forces guarding [[B-NK1]]'s base in the back room of the [[Dealer's Den]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
An MX-05 Constructor Droid appears as an enemy in the Republic [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] mission "The Shroud's Gambit" in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], the first Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
